title: Characterization of Fourier support
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional vector space over the field with two elements and a vector $\gamma$ in that space, $\gamma$ belongs to the vector Fourier support of $f$ if and only if its vector Fourier coefficient is nonzero.
